snowplow__atomic_schema.title: Schema
snowplow__atomic_schema.description: Schema (dataset) that contains your atomic events
snowplow__atomic_schema.longDescription: The schema (dataset for BigQuery) that contains your atomic events table.

snowplow__database.title: Database
snowplow__database.description: Database that contains your atomic events
snowplow__database.longDescription: The database that contains your atomic events table. Ignored on Databricks; use `snowplow__databricks_catalog` instead.

snowplow__events.title: Events Table
snowplow__events.longDescription: This is used internally by the package to reference your events table based on other variable values and should not be changed.

snowplow__start_date.title: Start Date
snowplow__start_date.longDescription: The earliest load_tstamp to process on the initial build or a full refresh. Verify source retention before rebuilding.
snowplow__start_date.description: The date to start processing events from on first run or a full refresh

snowplow__backfill_limit_days.title: Backfill Limit
snowplow__backfill_limit_days.longDescription: The normal forward window in days. Extended through the first eligible day after a gap or the upstream watermark. This does not guarantee a limit on bytes scanned.
snowplow__backfill_limit_days.description: Days in the normal forward processing window

snowplow__hash_identifiers.title: Hash Identifiers
snowplow__hash_identifiers.longDescription: When set to `true`, all identifier values stored in `snowplow_identities_identifier_mapping` are hashed using SHA-256 before being written to the table. Recommended when identifiers contain PII.
snowplow__hash_identifiers.description: Hash all identifier values with SHA-256 before storing them (recommended for PII compliance)

snowplow__identifiers.title: Identifiers
snowplow__identifiers.longDescription: The list of identifiers to extract from events and link to each `snowplow_id`. Each entry has a `reference` (the column name in your events table) and an `alias` (the name used in the output tables). Add any event-level fields you want to track as identifiers, such as `email` or `phone`.
snowplow__identifiers.description: > Click the plus sign to add a new entry

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Column name in the events table

alias.title: Alias
alias.description: Name to use in the output tables

snowplow__license_accepted.title: License accepted
snowplow__license_accepted.longDescription: Use this field to accept the Snowplow Personal and Academic License or specify that you have a commercial agreement with Snowplow.
snowplow__license_accepted.description: Use this field to accept the Snowplow user license.

snowplow__app_id.description: > Click the plus sign to add a new entry
snowplow__app_id.title: App IDs
snowplow__app_id.longDescription: Filter application identity-context events. Merge events use snowplow__identities_app_id separately.

snowplow__databricks_catalog.title: Databricks catalog
snowplow__databricks_catalog.description: Catalog that contains your atomic events on Databricks
snowplow__databricks_catalog.longDescription: The Databricks catalog containing your source events. Set the source schema with `snowplow__atomic_schema`. Configure the destination catalog and schema in your dbt profile.

snowplow__events_table.title: Events table name
snowplow__events_table.description: Name of your atomic events table
snowplow__events_table.longDescription: The name of the events table within your configured source database or catalog and schema.

snowplow__merge_limit_collapse.title: Merge-limit collapse
snowplow__merge_limit_collapse.description: Select a preferred owner without deleting other owners
snowplow__merge_limit_collapse.longDescription: Enable only when the service has no configured unique identifiers. All owners remain. is_preferred selects the latest sighting, breaking ties by oldest identity creation time. Missing creation dates or a remaining tie produce no preferred owner. Also applies to identifiers reappearing after TTL expiry.

snowplow__lookback_days.title: Lookback days
snowplow__lookback_days.description: Days of overlap re-read for late arrival. Backdated load timestamps outside the overlap require explicit reprocessing.
snowplow__lookback_days.longDescription: Days of overlap re-read for late arrival. Backdated load timestamps outside the overlap require explicit reprocessing.

snowplow__identities_app_id.title: Identity-service app IDs
snowplow__identities_app_id.description: Filter merge events by their service app_id. An empty list disables this filter.
snowplow__identities_app_id.longDescription: Filter merge events by their service app_id. An empty list disables this filter.

snowplow__partition_tstamp.title: Atomic partition column
snowplow__partition_tstamp.description: Physical partition column used to prune atomic source reads.
snowplow__partition_tstamp.longDescription: Physical partition column used to prune atomic source reads.

snowplow__partition_tstamp_type.title: Atomic partition type
snowplow__partition_tstamp_type.description: Type of the configured physical partition column.
snowplow__partition_tstamp_type.longDescription: Type of the configured physical partition column.

snowplow__partition_buffer_days.title: Partition buffer days
snowplow__partition_buffer_days.description: Extra days on the partition predicate when its column differs from load_tstamp. Must cover the actual arrival lag.
snowplow__partition_buffer_days.longDescription: Extra days on the partition predicate when its column differs from load_tstamp. Must cover the actual arrival lag.
